SELECT COUNT(*) FROM USER_AUTH_INFO UA LEFT JOIN user_mng um ON UA.USER_SEQ = um.USER_SEQ LEFT JOIN doctor_mapping_info di ON di.user_seq_fk = um.user_seq LEFT JOIN healthcare.guardian_mapping_info gmi ON gmi.user_seq_fk = um.user_seq
LEFT JOIN healthcare.user_auth_info UA2 ON UA2.USER_SEQ = (SELECT um2.user_seq FROM healthcare.user_mng um2 WHERE um2.user_id = #{userId}) LEFT JOIN healthcare.user_mng um2 ON um2.user_id = #{userId} AND um2.user_seq = UA2.USER_SEQ
AND UA.USER_ROLE_FK = #{userRoleFk}
AND um.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')
AND ( CASE WHEN UA2.user_role_fk = '4' THEN TRUE WHEN UA2.user_role_fk = '3' THEN (di.doctor_id = #{userId}) WHEN UA2.user_role_fk = '2' THEN (gmi.guardian_id = #{userId}) ELSE FALSE END )
AND UA.USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY um.user_nm DESC) AS ROWNUM , um.USER_SEQ , um.USER_ID , um.USER_NM , UA.USER_ROLE_FK , um.BIRTH_ENC , um.TEL_NUM_ENC , um.EMAIL , um.AGREEMENT_YN ,(SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY_AGG(umg3.user_nm),', ') FROM guardian_mapping_info gi LEFT JOIN user_mng umg3 ON gi.guardian_seq = umg3.user_seq WHERE gi.user_seq_fk = um.user_seq) AS parent_nm ,dm.user_nm AS doctor_nm ,COALESCE(( SELECT CASE WHEN MIN(hdm.spo2) <= 90 THEN true ELSE false END FROM healthcare.health_data_minute hdm WHERE hdm.user_seq = um.USER_SEQ AND hdm.receive_time = CURRENT_DATE AND hdm.spo2 != 0 GROUP BY hdm.user_seq ), false) as "warning" FROM USER_AUTH_INFO UA LEFT JOIN user_mng um ON UA.USER_SEQ = um.USER_SEQ LEFT JOIN doctor_mapping_info di ON di.user_seq_fk = um.user_seq LEFT JOIN user_mng dm ON di.doctor_seq = dm.user_seq LEFT JOIN healthcare.guardian_mapping_info gmi ON gmi.user_seq_fk = um.user_seq
LEFT JOIN healthcare.user_auth_info UA2 ON UA2.USER_SEQ = (SELECT um2.user_seq FROM healthcare.user_mng um2 WHERE um2.user_id = #{userId}) LEFT JOIN healthcare.user_mng um2 ON um2.user_id = #{userId} AND um2.user_seq = UA2.USER_SEQ
AND UA.USER_ROLE_FK = #{userRoleFk}
AND um.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%')
AND ( CASE WHEN UA2.user_role_fk = '4' THEN TRUE WHEN UA2.user_role_fk = '3' THEN (di.doctor_id = #{userId}) WHEN UA2.user_role_fk = '2' THEN (gmi.guardian_id = #{userId}) ELSE FALSE END )
AND UA.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY ROWNUM DESC
